2.1.rationale: The text defines abuse involving physical force or psychological/economic violence in an intimate/partner relationship as a felony, thereby establishing criminal penalties for a form of violence against women (domestic violence) with an attached criminal sanction.
2.1.evidence_original: Toda persona que empleare fuerza física o violencia psicológica o económica, intimidación o persecución en la persona de su cónyuge, ex cónyuge, o la persona con quien cohabita o haya cohabitado, o la persona con quien sostuviere o haya sostenido una relación consensual, o la persona con quien haya procreado un hijo o hija, independientemente del sexo, estado civil, involucradas en la relación, para causarle daño físico a su persona, al animal de compañía o mascota de la víctima, de los hijos o del victimario, a los bienes apreciados por esta, excepto aquellos que pertenecen privativamente al ofensor, o a la persona de otro o para causarle grave daño emocional, incurrirá en delito grave de cuarto grado en su mitad superior.

2.2.evidence:
Any person, eighteen (18) years of age or older, who has been a victim of domestic violence or conduct constituting a crime, as defined in this Law or in the Penal Code of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico [sic] or in any other special law, in the context of a partner relationship, as defined by subsection (m) of Article 1.3 of this Law, may file on their own behalf, through their legal representative or through a law enforcement officer, a petition with the Court and request a protection order, without the prior filing of a complaint or accusation being necessary.
When a court determines that there is cause for arrest based on a complaint in a criminal proceeding under Rule 6 of the Rules of Criminal Procedure, as amended, for any offense typified within this Law, and the accused is a repeat offender for violations of any of the offenses typified in this Law, it shall, without any additional proceeding, issue a protection order in favor of the victim for a period of validity that shall not be less than one (1) year and that may be extended at the discretion of a court and with the consent of the victim.
(a) Every protection order must specifically establish the court's determinations, the remedies ordered, and the period of validity.
(b) Every protection order must establish the date and time it was issued and expressly notify the parties that any violation thereof shall constitute contempt of court, which could result in a penalty of imprisonment, fine, or both.
2.2.rationale: The framework specifies who may apply for a protection order (victim, legal representative, or law enforcement officer), identifies the issuing authority (court), provides for duration/validity (including minimum periods in automatic issuance provisions), and states consequences for breach (contempt of court with possible imprisonment/fine).
2.2.evidence_original:

Cuando un tribunal determine que existe causa para el arresto a base de una denuncia en un procedimiento penal al amparo de las Regla 6 de las de Procedimiento Criminal, según enmendadas, por algún delito tipificado dentro de esta Ley, y el imputado sea reincidente por violaciones a cualquiera de los delitos tipificados en esta Ley, deberá, sin que medie procedimiento adicional alguno, emitir una orden de protección a favor de la víctima por un período de vigencia que no será menor de un (1) año y que podrá ser extendida a discreción de un tribunal y con la anuencia de la víctima.

(a) Toda orden de protección debe establecer específicamente las determinaciones del tribunal, los remedios ordenados y el periodo de vigencia.

(b) Toda orden de protección debe establecer la fecha y hora en que fue expedida y notificar expresamente a las partes que cualquier violación a la misma constituirá desacato al tribunal, lo que podría resultar en pena de reclusión, multa o ambas.

(i) Ordenar cualesquiera medidas provisionales respecto a la posesión y uso de la residencia de las partes y sobre aquellos bienes muebles enumerados y comprendidos en los incisos (1), (2), (3), (4), (4)(a), (5) y (6) del Artículo 249 del Código de Enjuiciamiento Civil, según enmendado (32 L.P.R.A. sec. 1130) la cual establece las propiedades exentas de ejecución. (j) Ordenar a la parte peticionada pagar una indemnización económica de su caudal privativo por los daños que fueren causados por la conducta constitutiva de violencia doméstica. Dicha indemnización podrá incluir, pero no estará limitada a compensación por gastos de mudanza, gastos por reparaciones a la propiedad, gastos legales, gastos médicos, psiquiátricos, psicológicos, de consejería, orientación, alojamiento, albergue y otros gastos similares, sin perjuicio de otras acciones civiles a las que tenga derecho la parte peticionaria.

4.9.evidence: Once the trial has been held and a conviction obtained or the accused makes a plea of guilty to any of the offenses defined in this Law, the Court may, on its own motion or upon request of the Prosecutor or the defense, suspend all proceedings and submit the convicted person to probation, subject to their participation in a reeducation and retraining program for persons who engage in abusive conduct in intimate partner relationships, as defined by subsection (m) of Article 1.3 of this Law.
4.9.rationale: The framework authorizes the court to suspend proceedings and submit the convicted person to probation conditioned on participation in a reeducation and retraining program for persons who engage in abusive conduct in intimate partner relationships, which is a perpetrator-focused behaviour-change/rehabilitation programme in an operative provision.
4.9.evidence_original: Una vez celebrado el juicio y convicto que fuere o que el acusado haga alegación de culpabilidad por cualesquiera de los delitos tipificados en esta Ley, el Tribunal podrá motu proprio o mediante solicitud del Ministerio Fiscal o de la defensa, suspender todo procedimiento y someter a la persona convicta a libertad a prueba, sujeto a que ésta participe en un programa de reeducación y readiestramiento para personas que incurren en conducta maltratante en la relación de pareja, según definida por el inciso (m) del Artículo 1.3 de esta Ley.

5.4.indicator: Prevention through education and improving the quality of education
5.4.rationale: While the text includes education programs/workshops for domestic violence prevention, it does not explicitly identify formal educational institutions, curricula, teaching materials, or education-system quality improvements as prevention measures for violence against women/domestic violence. References to a children’s school are incidental to protection-order guidance rather than an education-based prevention measure.

5.5.rationale: The candidate sentences do not establish prevention activities specifically engaging men or boys (e.g., targeting men/boys for norm change or positive masculinity). References to “boys and girls” relate to service programs for children from homes with abuse, and perpetrator-focused education/workshops are framed as conditions/remedies rather than explicit engagement of men/boys as a target group for primary prevention of violence against women.

6.1.indicator: Engagement/collaboration with civil society organisations and NGOs
6.1.evidence: Any person who has accredited training or studies in the area of counseling, guidance, psychology, social work or legal intercession and who is certified by the Office of the Women's Advocate or by a private nonprofit entity authorized to issue such certifications according to the regulations approved by the Office of the Women's Advocate for such purposes may serve as an Intercessor.
6.1.rationale: The framework includes an operative provision explicitly involving a private nonprofit entity in a formal role (authorised to issue certifications for Intercessors/Advocates under regulations), which constitutes a mechanism for NGO participation in the response to domestic violence (victim support/advocacy).
6.1.evidence_original: Podrá fungir como personal de apoyo cualquier persona mayor de edad que escoja la víctima, sea un familiar o no. Podrá fungir como Intercesor o Intercesora toda persona que cuente con los adiestramientos o estudios acreditados en el área de consejería, orientación, psicología, trabajo social o intercesión legal y que esté certificada por la Oficina de la Procuradora de las Mujeres o por una entidad privada sin fines de lucro autorizada a emitir dichas certificaciones según la reglamentación que apruebe la Oficina de la Procuradora de las Mujeres a esos efectos.

6.2.indicator: Engagement/collaboration with religious and traditional organisations or leaders
6.2.rationale: None of the candidate sentences mention religious organisations/leaders or traditional/cultural organisations/leaders, nor do they establish any collaboration mechanism with such actors in relation to domestic violence/VAW.

6.3.rationale: The text references a child’s school only as a place to notify/provide a copy of a protection order, and mentions education programs/workshops generally, but it does not establish or require collaboration with schools/universities as institutions for VAW prevention/response or assign them responsibilities.

6.4.rationale: The candidate sentences do not mention international organisations or any operative mechanism for cooperation with them on domestic violence/VAW.

6.5.rationale: The candidate sentences do not identify media organisations/actors or establish any media-related collaboration mechanism for prevention, awareness, or response to domestic violence/VAW.

6.6.rationale: While the text includes general statements about uniting efforts and provides guidance recommending that victims notify neighbors and other local actors, it does not establish an operative mechanism requiring or authorising community/public participation or collaboration in VAW prevention/response (beyond victim self-protection steps).

6.7.indicator: Engagement/collaboration with business and private sector
6.7.evidence: Every cellular telephone service provider company shall transfer without any additional cost the responsibility, control and change of the telephone number, as well as the cellular telephone number or numbers of any minor under the custody of the person to whom a Protection Order has been issued in his/her favor.
6.7.rationale: The framework imposes an operative obligation on private-sector cellular telephone service provider companies to take specific actions for persons with protection orders, which is a form of mandated private-sector participation supporting victims’ safety in the response to domestic violence/VAW.
6.7.evidence_original: Toda compañía proveedora de servicio telefónico celular transferirá sin ningún costo adicional la responsabilidad, control y cambio del número telefónico, así como el número o números de teléfonos celulares de cualquier menor bajo la custodia de la persona a la que se le haya expedido a su favor una Orden de Protección.
